entries.note: Run the existing launcher and new native executable through the real detached-supervisor bootstrap, then request the next update through the bound CLI. Repeated/concurrent launches reuse a single native view and one original CLI invocation. A separate empty-workspace case must create no terminal or agent. Cleanup stops only fixture supervisor/view processes before closing its fixture host; no OS shortcut injection or live owner session is used.
